q2: WITH BeerBars AS (SELECT serves.beer AS beer, MAX(serves.price) AS max_price, MIN(serves.price) AS min_price, AVG(serves.price) AS avg_price FROM serves WHERE serves.bar IN (SELECT frequents.bar FROM frequents WHERE frequents.drinker LIKE 'B%') GROUP BY serves.beer HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT serves.bar) >= 2) SELECT bb.beer AS beer, CASE WHEN max_price = min_price THEN max_price ELSE max_price - min_price END AS price_gap, bb.avg_price AS avg_price FROM BeerBars AS bb ORDER BY bb.beer
